(1) TOML: Python 3.12 tomllib parses task.toml (keys schema_version, artifacts, task, metadata, agent, environment, verifier), tests/scoring.toml ([gates] render/constraints 0.0, [weights] 0.6/0.2/0.2, [floors] functional 0.05) and all five tests/{gates,scored}/*/judge.toml without error; all LF, no BOM. (2) Judge schema: each [judge] has judge='claude-code', mode, timeout, isolated=false, prompt_template='prompt.md'; no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight; criteria 1/1/15/5/5, all with id, type binary|likert (likert has points), weight>0, non-empty description, no duplicate ids; every prompt.md contains {criteria} and {app_context} and no other placeholder. Functional uses mode='individual' (only task in projects/ doing so, and different from the contract skeleton's 'batched'); RewardKit 0.1.7 source models.py:142 declares JudgeMode = Literal['batched','individual'] and judges.py:460 dispatches agent judges to _arun_agent_individual. Loading every judge.toml through the real 0.1.7 runner._build_judge_reward (isolation and litellm stubbed in a private temp copy; REWARDKIT_MODEL set) returned AgentJudge for all five: constraints batched 1, render batched 1, functional individual 15, polish batched 5, visual batched 5, with no ValueError (prompt_template .md suffix and {criteria} checks pass). (3) Shell: bash -n passes on tests/test.sh and solution/solve.sh, both have the #!/bin/bash shebang and LF endings; the app-restart.sh heredoc in test.sh, extracted and placeholder-substituted the way test.sh's sed does, also passes bash -n with no leftover __ placeholders. No CRLF or BOM anywhere in the task tree. test.sh, tests/Dockerfile, .dockerignore, tools/score.py and tools/restart_mcp.py and environment/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template; score.py and restart_mcp.py parse with ast. Both seed_data.json copies parse and are byte-identical (28549 bytes). db.js honours DB_PATH; the server listens on PORT || 3000.
